check_item: Task is a single-arm tabletop cup transfer with fixed start zone, target zone and object list
acceptance_rule: Define zones, object IDs, operator ID hash, device ID and task instruction before collection
evidence_or_basis: Derived from UMI 50-demo community principle and LeRobot task metadata requirements: SRC-robotics-068;SRC-robotics-053

check_item: Camera, pose source, gripper width source and timebase are recording
acceptance_rule: Every episode has video, pose, width and timestamps; missing channel triggers re-record or rejected label
evidence_or_basis: UMI stores RGB, pose and width arrays; LeRobot requires synchronized state/action/image rows: SRC-robotics-068;SRC-robotics-053

check_item: Camera intrinsics/extrinsics and tracker-to-TCP transform are versioned
acceptance_rule: Calibration version is written to manifest before first episode and after any hardware change
evidence_or_basis: Production metadata recommendation from dataset schema comparison; source-backed formats in SRC-robotics-053

check_item: Collect 100 attempted demonstrations, including failures and re-record reasons
acceptance_rule: Do not report 100 as valid data unless QC confirms effective episodes; raw attempts are preserved
evidence_or_basis: 100 demonstrations is a v0 target from the UMI business plan; failure retention follows HIL/failure-data sources: SRC-robotics-097

check_item: Episode starts before grasp approach and ends after stable placement or failure stop
acceptance_rule: Start/end frame indices are reviewed; ambiguous boundaries get reviewer note
evidence_or_basis: UMI uses episode_ends; LeRobot uses episode metadata offsets: SRC-robotics-068;SRC-robotics-053

check_item: Wrist RGB is readable and task-relevant
acceptance_rule: Reviewer marks pass/fail for blur, occlusion, field of view and lighting; no numeric threshold is assumed before pilot calibration
evidence_or_basis: No source-backed numeric threshold found; keep qualitative until measured in pilot

check_item: Pose trajectory is continuous enough for replay/training
acceptance_rule: Flag SLAM or pose-source loss, jumps, drift and missing ranges; set pass/fail with reviewer note
evidence_or_basis: UMI README and hardware note identify SLAM/pose robustness as core risk: SRC-robotics-067

check_item: Gripper width signal is present and aligned to video
acceptance_rule: Flag missing width, stuck width and obvious desync; do not infer true force from width
evidence_or_basis: UMI stores robot0_gripper_width; width is not a force sensor: SRC-robotics-068

check_item: Outcome and failure cause are labeled
acceptance_rule: Each attempt has success, partial_success, failed, or rejected plus a reason code
evidence_or_basis: Failure/intervention assets require outcome and reason labels: SRC-robotics-097; research-notes/failure-intervention-data-2026-05-27

check_item: UMI/Zarr and LeRobot exports are generated from the same manifest
acceptance_rule: Record exporter version, source manifest hash and output path for both formats
